detail.longDescription: RTX 5090 vs 24GB for local LLMs: at 4K context, 103 of 129 indexed models fit the 5090 vs 97 on a 24GB card. The real gain is context room on 27B–36B models and 1,792 GB/s bandwidth. A 70B Q4_K_M at 8K (~47.5GB) still needs two cards. Write-up: https:// quantized.uk/cookbook/rtx5090- 32gb-what-to-run/ Calculator: https:// quantized.uk/tools/vram-calc/ # LocalLLM # LLM # SelfHosted
